assumptions: At most one source decoding or replay worker at a time.
SQLite and decoder temporary outputs absent during export/readback.
Readback processes one<=128MiB part at a time then removes it.
Local external export retains one transport copy; no duplicate full publication copy.
Import parts and reconstructed CAS coexist; stage-to-CAS adoption is a link/unlink, not a file copy.
Replay writes at most1GiB transient evidence plus512MiB SQLite and one32MiB partition; cleanup precedes pointer selection.
Retained generations already present are measured separately in Store.capacity; no pruning.
Main and isolated caches each enforce their quota, actual filesystem reserve and staged usage repeatedly.
Source is exactly the pinned959035282-byte shard; a different larger source needs a new budget.
